labels: enhancement

## Problem

<!-- What's the user-facing problem this feature would solve? "I want to
     see bus arrivals on my lock screen" or "I want to know when the
     next ferry arrives" — concrete scenarios, not abstract wishes. -->

## Proposed solution

<!-- Describe the feature concretely. What would the user see / do?
     What URL/hash would they visit? What UI element would appear?
     What data source would back it? -->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- What other approaches did you consider? Why is this one better?
     If you considered doing nothing, say why. -->

## Out of scope (for this issue)

<!-- What's explicitly NOT part of this request? This helps reviewers
     understand the boundary. -->

## Open questions

<!-- Anything you don't have an answer for yet — license concerns, data
     source availability, performance budget, i18n. -->

## Willingness to contribute

<!-- PRs are welcome. If you're planning to open one, say so here so we
     can discuss the approach early. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the
     workflow. -->

- [ ] I'd like to open a PR for this
- [ ] I'm open to a PR if someone else takes it
- [ ] Discussion only — no current plan to implement

## Additional context

<!-- Screenshots of similar features in other apps, links to upstream
     data sources, links to relevant Hong Kong government pages, etc. -->

## Checklist

<!-- Mark with an `x` for completed items. -->

- [ ] I checked the [open issues](https://github.com/rollroyces/buseta-hk/issues)
      and confirmed this isn't a duplicate
- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) (especially the
      "what won't be merged" section)
- [ ] I understand this is a vanilla-JS, zero-build-step project —
      PRs that add build tooling or framework dependencies won't be
      merged
